mechanism: Both drugs are teratogenic and hepatotoxic; isotretinoin is absolutely contraindicated in pregnancy while propylthiouracil is preferred for thyroid disease in pregnancy, creating a complex risk profile in women of childbearing potential.
action: Avoid concurrent use in women of childbearing age; if both required, use propylthiouracil with strict pregnancy prevention program for isotretinoin and monitor liver function tests closely.
